### FIN-00000001-0037
Reconciliation FIN-00000001-0037 was opened for Northbridge Systems in the retail segment. The reviewed amount was ₹109,229, quantity 12, with current state pending. The principal variance category was configuration mismatch.
Finance compared the relevant invoice, purchase order, receiving or service evidence and payment event. The reconciliation distinguishes an invoice date, approval date, settlement date and bank-posting date. A payment can be initiated without being visible in the customer's bank at the same moment.
The record also preserves the legal billing entity and currency. Values in this synthetic corpus are INR unless a separate contract says otherwise.
